what: Can the held-out DNA judge be improved cheaply? AUC on Luo test / Azimuth test / Kim test.
verdict: Gains are about 0.01 AUC, within noise for these test sizes, and the added lab would blur the judge's independence. Not adopted. Headroom from these sequence features looks small; more gain would need new information (chromatin, epigenetic context), not a bigger model.
